en: I regret to say that I cannot aid you, $gnoble sir:gentle lady;, until you learn more of working with leather. Speak with Faldron or Darianna here instead. They can teach you the skill you require.
When he came upon the refugees at the Greymane Wall, he felt it his duty to succor them, sending his woman on to Hillsbrad.
Elder Darkcore can be found in the Undercity.
Save me...

Friend - Stormwind needs your assistance and your generosity!$B$BOur once large stockpile of textiles has run critically low.  Stormwind is now engaged in a multi-pronged effort to rebuild those stocks for the manufacture of textiles and bandages!  Your donation of cloth would help Stormwind immensely, as well as earn the respect of the citizenry!
Soon, your thirst for destruction will be quenched.
What?!  You no can beat me!  Me will return!
The Stonehearth Bunker protects the eastern flank of the Field of Strife.$B$BIt is controlled by neither side.
%s splits into two new Lava Spawns!
The legion of Blackrock comes, dwarflings! We shall scorch the earth and set fire to the heavens. None shall survive...
All will know of what has transpired here in this accursed temple, hero. It will be written about in history books - the tales told as legend from Azeroth to the far reaches of the Nether itself!
%s pokes the wooly sheep repeatedly.
Almost back to Ratchet! Let's keep up the pace...
%s crushes the tear into a bowl of stew.
You do fine work, but it's a bit rough around the edges. Don't worry about it, it will come with practice. Speaking of which, how about we see what you've been working on?
Tell me more about these Darkmoon Cards.
%s's death wail has stirred the nearby silithid hive!

Hello, $c. I'm sure that I don't need to inform you of the gravity of our situation here. We need to gather many goods, and in most cases assemble them into materiel, to be transported to Cenarion Hold in Silithus. This is no small effort.$B$BRecently in the Molten Core we discovered something called a singed corestone. Our blacksmiths and engineers tell us that they can put them to good use, so I'm supervising their accumulation here. As of now, out of $2110w needed, we've managed to collect $2108w.
$n has assaulted the farm!
Stand straight!  Your weakness sickens me!
No longer will we wait behind barred doors and walls of stone! No longer will our vengeance be denied! The dragons themselves will tremble before our wrath!

Haha, you be pullin' me leg mon. Pele'keiki know that you know we Horde already be havin' all the war stuff we be needin'. Now we just waitin' on that Alliance to get all theirs and we startin' up the war.
Hey, $n. Over here, I want to talk to you.

Salutations.  My function is to offer access to and, when permissible, insight into information regarding the Creators' synthesis of the Earthen on the world designated as Azeroth.  I am ready to share this information with you now at your leisure.
What you must understand is that being able to index 10,000 years of existence has given me a rather unique perspective on life. Your present day trials and tribulations are meaningless.

All right then... I know the way to and from Gadgetzan.  What I need for you to do is to keep the beasts off of us.  I've trained Dadanga how to defend herself pretty well, but we can't handle the overgrown madness out there for long.  Let me know when you're ready to go, $n.
Let's get to the others, and keep an eye open for those wolves outside...
This is Dalin Forgewright. He fled from Lordaeron when the plague struck, taking his love with him.
What are professions?
I will teach you the way of the hammersmith. Just ask nicely.
The dead walk among us!
%s is lured out into the open!
Yaw Sharpmane awaits you on the north edge of the village.  He can teach you the ways of the Hunter.
Praise Elune! It has been many years since I have had visitors.
I walk this road alone, seeking ways to defend my honor and rid this land of our enemies.$B$BWhat can I do for you, $n?
The Alliance has many stakes in Desolace, and our hold here is unstable.$B$BWill you help us?
Humans are usually vunerable on their left side between the 4th and 5th rib. Let's practice striking at this area like so...
We have a large store of supplies to rebuild Frostwolf Keep.  Just a little bit more and we'll have enough to repair and reenter the battle!
